<td style="text-align:center; width:20%; border:solid 1px silver" bgcolor=#{{#if:{{{bg|}}}|{{{bg}}}|FFFFFF}}>
[[{{{page}}}|<font color="white">{{#if: {{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{{page}}}}}</font>]]<font color="white">{{{ref|}}}<br />{{{combatants|}}}</font>
</td><noinclude>


This template is one of several used to create the [[Timeline of the Galactic Civil War]]. This is used for dark-colored cells, and has several parameters&mdash;"bg" for color, "page" for the battle article, the optional "text" for pipelinking, "ref" for references, and "combatants".

[[Category:Timeline utility templates]]
</noinclude>
